description: This file defines a Composable function `CanvasScreen` which creates and manages a WebView for rendering web content within an Android Jetpack Compose UI. The file also contains a `JavascriptInterface` class `CanvasA2UIActionBridge` for handling JavaScript messages from the WebView. It configures the WebView with specific settings, handles lifecycle events, and manages logging for debugging.

classes.name: CanvasA2UIActionBridge
classes.description: A JavaScript interface class that facilitates communication from the WebView's JavaScript to the Android application. It validates if the page is trusted before executing the callback with the message payload.

methods.name: CanvasA2UIActionBridge.postMessage
methods.description: Exposes a JavaScript interface method that receives a string payload, validates trust, and triggers a callback with the message.
